description: Checks a player's answer to the open trivia clue, scores it and returns the ruling with the answer, or the next step of a stepped clue. In a survey game it checks an answer against the hidden board; in a letter game it takes a called letter or a solve attempt, in the player's own words; in a timeline game it takes where the open card goes (before X, between X and Y, at the end), in the player's own words; in Worms! it takes the face to keep ("the fours", "worms"), "roll again" or "stop", and "take" or "steal"; in Yacht it takes the dice to keep ("the threes", "keep 3 3 5", "keep all", "none", "reroll the one") or "score it", then the box ("full house", "fours", "chance") and a yes or no to "Take a zero?"; in Pigs! it takes "yes" (throw again) or "no" (bank).

answer.description: What the player said, in their words

player.description: The answering player's name, for the scores
